title: PersonaMix Solo #02 (솔로 · 도자기=항아 · 도자기 청자 · 앵글 기본(허리 높이) · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Chinese · 메이크업 걸크러시(포인트) · 배경 얼음 동굴 · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, mid 30s, Chang'e, the Chinese moon goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, half-up half-down copper red hair — full body glazed celadon porcelain fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid glazed porcelain curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted porcelain sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING soft jade-green celadon glaze with incised lotus and cloud patterns across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID darker green pooled glaze and fine crackle lines running between the sections, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, glossy glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: mid-stride runway walk toward the camera, shoulders back, one boot crossing in front of the other — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same porcelain, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same porcelain with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT porcelain — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a bright blue-white glacier ice cave lit by daylight through the ice, a flat frozen floor and a standard-height wooden walkway rail, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.

poses: mid-stride runway walk toward the camera, shoulders back, one boot crossing in front of the other
